title: Oracle preparation in two steps
statement: For every Boolean input word $x$, tape content $f\colon\mathbb{Z}\to\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Bool})$, side bit, valid input-head position, and output word, running the oracle-dispatch machine for two steps from the local configuration at position zero in the corresponding bookmark state yields the ready configuration at position zero, with empty argument word and copy state, preserving the input-head position and output.
